name: Xenia
author: sd88me
summary: An emulation of the Microwave XT wavetable synthesizer's original firmware (gearmulator's 68k and DSP56300 emulators) as a native instrument for Gen2 MPC devices, with a PLAY page laid out like the XT's front panel (LCD in the ellipse, red data dial, Play knobs), two skins, ROM banks and patch browser, named favourites, RANDOM and Q-Link control on every page. Gen2 (aarch64) only; you need your own Microwave XT ROM.
